Name: Jabin, King of Canaan
Summary: Jabin, king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor, oppressed Israel twenty years with nine hundred chariots of iron until Deborah and Barak defeated his captain Sisera at the Kishon. He is distinct from the earlier Jabin of Hazor in Joshua.
KeyStory: Jabin's iron chariots terrorised Israel for twenty years until Deborah sent Barak against Sisera, and God discomfited the whole host at the Kishon.
LifeLesson: Iron chariots look unbeatable until the river rises.
